assertions: Original3attribute value/factory/Clone/typed Any/default behavior reuses existing shared owners.
Native metric defaults/kerning scaling and integral conversion preserve sign, narrowing and producer-domain semantics.

stackDivergence.rationale: Task152 implements actual SvxAutoKernItem/SvxKerningItem/SvxCharScaleWidthItem native value/copy/factory/concrete Clone families on existing shared bool/signed16/unsigned16 owners. Actual EditEngine defaults are false4053,0twips4054 and100percent4045 from original eerdll/eeitem/solar; no dummy pool is introduced. Automatic pair kerning reuses real bool Any; manual spacing reuses signed16 state and typed short Any with integral common twip/mm100 helpers and original final signed16 narrowing. Only the twips flag matters; other selector bits are ignored. Width keeps unsigned16 state with signed16 Any transport and no invented percent bound: short-1 stores65535. Existing inherited scalar queries and checked host scalar constructor/setter domains remain explicit. Kerning ScaleMetrics uses the same sign-corrected JS Math.round and native BigInt narrowing pattern already used for font height, representing only the defined finite signed64 llround domain. Native BigInt::Scale(double) is just std::llround; no native BigInt class/library/lifetime facade is ported. Original poolitem no-op ScaleMetrics and false HasMetrics are restored, kerning overrides to true;5existing metric owners gain18override declarations with identical emitted JS, not new executable behavior. Existing451line textitem owner cannot fit this complete family under500lines; canonical3headers reexport the necessary source responsibility split. Original derived localized GetPresentation remains unported; inherited generic base presentation is not certified as derived UI presentation. UI localization is deferred, actual EditEngine/EditTextObject/ScPageHFItem/Calc pool/model/connected UI/same-model ODS pending. Original conversion narrowing and signed width transport preserved, statuses and I/O/recovery deviations unchanged.
